pricing.basis: OpenAI official GPT-6 Sol model page, checked 2026-11-04; Standard text-token prices per million, under the model's short-context tier (this frozen pack is well below the long-context threshold). Other tiers/regions/account routing may differ; the 6x reservation remains a conservative ceiling, not proof of account billing.

reservation.rule: Proof B's rule, reused: before each request reserve (UTF-8 bytes of the whole request body + 1000) input tokens and max_output_tokens output tokens at the reservation rates; send only if the committed bound plus that reservation is within the ceiling; afterwards the bound grows by the validated usage at the reservation rates, or by the whole reservation when usage is missing or the attempt failed.

manifest.one_run_policy: Exactly one run: the journal is claimed by exclusive create; existing evidence in the tree or in any commit refuses a new run; an interrupted run is incomplete and is never rerun.
manifest.stop_rule: Stop at the first provider ERROR (transport, HTTP status, malformed or incomplete reply, output over the cap, unconfirmed model) or an ambiguous refusal, and at the request or currency limit; every later case is NOT_ATTEMPTED. Any case without a reply makes the run INCOMPLETE; it is never scored as a success.
